description: This file defines the class RetrieveThingDefinitionResponse, which represents the response to a retrieve Thing Definition command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the retrieved thing's ID and definition, and serializing the response to JSON.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a RetrieveThingDefinition command, encapsulating the Thing ID, its definition, status, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveThingDefinitionResponse with specified Thing ID, definition, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveThingDefinitionResponse object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this response, which is V_2.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the Thing definition.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity (Thing definition) from a JSON value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource within the JSON payload.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response's payload into a JSON object builder.
